plain_language_summary: Infrared wellness devices use infrared light or heat as part of at-home recovery and relaxation routines.
educational_notes: Infrared is often discussed in wellness contexts for heat exposure, comfort, and recovery routines.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Not medical advice.

plain_language_summary: Infrared sauna blankets are designed for heat-based at-home wellness sessions.
educational_notes: Session length, heat level, hydration, and user comfort should guide beginner use.
safety_framing: Follow product instructions. Avoid overheating and stop use if discomfort occurs.

plain_language_summary: Infrared heat exposure should be approached conservatively, especially by beginners.
educational_notes: More heat or longer sessions are not automatically better. Hydration and comfort matter.
safety_framing: People with heat sensitivity, cardiovascular conditions, pregnancy, or serious health concerns should consult a qualified professional before use.

plain_language_summary: Infrared and red light are different parts of the electromagnetic spectrum and may be used differently depending on device design.
educational_notes: Red light is often discussed for skin-facing routines, while infrared is commonly discussed for heat or deeper exposure contexts.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Review device-specific instructions and safety notes.

plain_language_summary: Infrared and terahertz are separate spectrum categories and should not be treated as identical.
educational_notes: Some wellness devices may compare these modalities, but spectrum category, device design, and user experience differ.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Avoid assuming different modalities have the same use or safety profile.

plain_language_summary: Hydration is an important consideration during heat-based wellness routines such as infrared sauna blanket sessions.
educational_notes: Users should follow product instructions, hydrate appropriately, and avoid overuse.
safety_framing: People with fluid restrictions or medical concerns should follow professional healthcare guidance.

plain_language_summary: Beginners should start with lower heat and shorter sessions before gradually adjusting based on comfort and device instructions.
educational_notes: Comfort, hydration, heat tolerance, and session length should be monitored.
safety_framing: Stop use if dizziness, overheating, nausea, skin irritation, or discomfort occurs.

plain_language_summary: Infrared heat may not be appropriate for every person.
educational_notes: People with cardiovascular concerns, pregnancy, heat sensitivity, serious medical conditions, or medication-related heat sensitivity should ask a qualified professional before use.
safety_framing: Educational reference only. Not a substitute for medical guidance.
